requirements.requirement: The system must include a unit test that verifies identical inputs to the scoring algorithm produce identical composite scores across multiple executions.
The system must include a unit test that validates the composite score equals the weighted sum of input measures using the configured fixed weights.
The system must include a unit test that verifies normalization logic produces consistent scale outputs for varying input ranges.
The system must include a unit test that enforces rejection or error when fewer than 3 quality measures are provided as input.
The system must include a unit test that validates correct handling when exactly 3 measures are provided (minimum valid case).
The system must include a unit test that verifies additional measures beyond 3 are incorporated correctly into the weighted score.
The system must include a unit test that confirms null or missing measure values are either excluded or handled according to defined scoring rules without causing crashes.
The system must include a unit test that verifies the scoring algorithm raises a deterministic error or returns a defined fallback when all measures are null or missing.
The system must include a unit test that ensures weight configurations sum to an expected total (e.g., 1.0) and produce predictable output when valid.
The system must include a unit test that verifies behavior when weight configuration is invalid (e.g., sums not equal to expected total) results in a controlled failure or validation error.
The system must include a unit test that confirms the scoring output schema matches the defined Pydantic model structure.
The system must include a unit test that validates floating point precision is consistent and within an acceptable tolerance for repeated calculations.
